findings.title: findMany removed without migrating callers
findings.body: The public `findMany` method was replaced by `getBaseConditions`. Any existing callers of `InsightsBookingService.findMany`, such as insights tRPC routers, will break at compile time or at runtime. Nothing in this diff updates those callers.

findings.title: Caching tests deleted
findings.body: The tests that verified caching of authorization and filter conditions were removed, even though the caching logic still exists in the service. That behavior is now untested.

findings.title: Org scope user IDs skipped when org has no child teams
findings.body: `userIdsFromOrg` is only computed when `teamsFromOrg.length > 0`, even though `teamIds` always includes `orgId`. In an org with no sub-teams, the org members' personal bookings are excluded from org-scope results. This logic predates the PR but was carried over unchanged.
